title: Physics Lab harness lifecycle capability fence
objective: Close the confirmed source-only ownership hole where PhysicsLabStudioHarness.get() exposes the raw RealizedLab.destroy() capability and can leave the harness bound to a destroyed lab, without broadening into multiplayer transport or Studio evidence work.
acceptance: callers outside the harness cannot destroy the owned lab while leaving the private current owner stale
use the narrowest production-worthy seam: centralize destroy/release under the harness or return an operational facade that does not expose uncoordinated destroy authority
Harness.get() and any replacement surface preserve the minimum read/diagnostic access actually required by existing source consumers without exposing the private ownership capability
stop remains nil-tolerant and idempotent and destroys the currently owned lab before releasing ownership
restart preserves destroy-before-reacquire ordering and exactly-one-lab ownership
Studio-only and server-only assertions remain fail-closed
add pure/source-contract regression proving an external handle cannot leave current bound to a destroyed lab and deterministic replacement remains possible
do not alter PhysicsLabRealizer ownership architecture, StableIds, world truth, networking, persistence, or fidelity policy
do not claim Roblox Studio, real two-client, replication/session, transport, or HG151-TWOCLIENT evidence from source-only validation
canonical CI, live pr-ownership after the separately owned trusted-history recovery, and fresh independent exact-head review are required before integration
